- memory_id "1000132": The job scheduler lives with the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)

- memory_id "1000090": As of 2025-01-10, the Ember team is a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000338" [decision]: As of 2025-04-21, the Dune team adopted a monthly game day.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000296" [constraint]: As of 2025-03-31, anything Ember-related should be paged to Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000183": The job scheduler depends on feature-flags for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)

- memory_id "1000240": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000285": As of 2025-03-26, the Dune team observed that after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000220" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000272": As of 2025-03-20, the image resizer is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000167": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004, broker)
- memory_id "1000356": As of 2025-04-24, feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000256": As of 2025-03-07, the billing API lives with the Ember team.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
